description: Change a saved post template. Only the fields passed are changed, and each one passed replaces the stored value entirely (e.g. account_ids replaces the whole list).

account_ids.description: Connected account UUIDs the template targets (max 50) — from list_connections.

content.description: Default post text, up to 20,000 characters.

content_overrides.description: Per-platform text that replaces content for that platform, as platform → text.

platform_settings.description: Per-platform publish settings, as platform → settings object (same keys as schedule_post's platform_meta).

name: update_post_template
